# Bilal Ali Salon

> Premium men's grooming salon in Lebanon, founded by barber Bilal Ali. Precision cuts, beard care, styling and hair-care products, by appointment.

- Location: Lebanon, Verdun Street, 732 Building
- Phone / WhatsApp: +961 3 850 966
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bilalali_officiall
- TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@bilalali_officiall
